beats.say: Your AI is smart, but it cannot touch your files.
beats.show: Robot reaches for a filing drawer; the drawer is locked.
beats.because: So we need a way in.
beats.label: Locked Drawer
beats.visualAction: Robot reaches for a filing drawer; the drawer is locked.

beats.say: An MCP server is a plug that fits any tool.
beats.show: A small adapter box appears between robot and drawer.
beats.because: But a single adapter can open any drawer.
beats.label: The Adapter
beats.visualAction: A small adapter box appears between robot and drawer.

beats.say: The server lists what it can do.
beats.show: Three labeled cards slide out of the adapter: read, search, write.
beats.because: So the AI sees a menu, not a mystery.
beats.label: The Menu
beats.visualAction: Three labeled cards slide out of the adapter: read, search, write.

beats.say: The AI picks one. The server does the work.
beats.show: Robot taps 'read'; the drawer opens and a page floats back.
beats.because: So the AI never touches the drawer itself.
beats.label: One Call
beats.visualAction: Robot taps read; the drawer opens and a page floats back.

beats.show: Robot, adapter, open drawer hold still in wide empty space.
beats.label: Breather Hold
beats.visualAction: Robot, adapter and open drawer hold still in wide negative space.

beats.say: One adapter opens every drawer: files, mail, dates.
beats.show: The locked drawer turns into six. The one adapter plugs into each.
beats.because: But the first drawer was only the start.
beats.label: Every Drawer
beats.visualAction: The locked drawer multiplies into six; the one adapter plugs into each.

beats.show: Pull back to the first frame; drawer open, robot calm, echoing beat 1.
beats.because: So remember the plug, not the wiring.
beats.label: Calm Callback
beats.visualAction: Final frame echoes Beat 1: drawer open, robot calm, first pose held.
